result.title: RA$^2$: Retain-Anchored Attraction Preserves Forget-Adjacent Utility in LLM Unlearning
result.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is often evaluated primarily by target suppression and clean retain utility. These metrics can miss a local failure mode: a model may perform well on standard retain prompts, yet degrade on benign reasoning when prompts lie near the forgotten domain. This phenomenon is termed forget-adjacent utility loss. A fundamental question is: where should forget representations go after they leave the removed behavior? Successful unlearning depends not only on whether forget-conditioned representations depart from the harmful computation, but also on the direction in which they are redirected afterward. We propose RA$^2$ (Retain-Anchored Attraction), a latent-space unlearning method that redirects forget-token states toward nearby retain-supported representations while preserving higher-layer behavior on retain data. On WMDP and MUSE, RA$^2$ yields higher forget-adjacent utility than strong unlearning baselines at similar broad-utility levels. These results show that the migration direction of forget representations materially affects benign behavior near the forget boundary. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZacLing/retain_anchored_attraction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RA$^2$，一种 latent 空间遗忘方法：把 forget token 的隐状态重定向到邻近的 retain 支持表示，同时保持 retain 数据在高层的原有行为，以缓解「遗忘邻域效用损失」——即靠近遗忘领域的良性推理退化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心操作是在隐状态层面按「锚点」定向迁移表示，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新方向与约束方式提供借鉴线索，且「邻域效用损失」这一诊断思路可供核查 latent 内容是否保留任务必要信息；但任务为文本 LLM 遗忘，与视觉多模态推理距离较远。
